'''Sensor array controller/interpreter''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] component used in [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] class spaceships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It was a component in the Falcon's sensor array.
